signalling_question: Is there potential for confounding of the effect of exposure?
Did the analysis appropriately control the important confounders?
Was exposure characterised using validated, reliable methods?
Could exposure measurement have been affected by knowledge of, or presence of, the outcome (differential misclassification)?
Was selection into the study unrelated to exposure and outcome?
Did start of follow-up and start of exposure coincide?
Were post-exposure interventions that affect the outcome balanced across exposure groups?
Were outcome and exposure data available for nearly all participants?
Is there evidence the result was not biased by missing data?
Could the outcome measure have been influenced by knowledge of exposure status?
Were outcome ascertainment methods comparable across exposure groups?
Was the result reported in accordance with a pre-specified analysis plan?
Is the reported result likely selected from multiple measurements or analyses on the basis of the results?
